notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
🍬 Sweet news, Candy Shop fans! 🍬

A brand-new Sweet Update has just arrived in Candy Shop: Sweet Start! 🎉

[u][b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/u]
✨ Improved UI – it now scales correctly for all screen ratios, even ultra-wide monitors like the Samsung Odyssey G9.
✨ Fixed an issue where a worker and customer could get stuck if the player was blocked by an action.
✨ The pinned recipe is now visible while managing the pantry.
✨ Doors stuck on the edge of the map can now be moved or deleted.

Thank you for all your sweet feedback – keep it coming, and enjoy the smoother candy-making experience! 🍭💖

See you soon,
Candy Shop : Sweet Start Team

notes.title: Release Date for Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Candy Lovers! 👋[/b][/h1]
[h3]We're happy to announce that [b]Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start[/b] will soon be ready for you to enjoy! 🔥[/h3]
[h3][b]When?[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]On August 25, 2025 at 12:00 PM CEST![/b][/h2]
[h3]Join us in another chapter of our development! 👇 [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645040/Candy_Shop_Simulator_Sweet_Start
[h3]What is Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start?[/h3]

It is a standalone free experience sprinkled by the culmination of our recent development. 🧁
We talked about a lot of exciting things in our devlogs and we want you to finally experience it!  🤩

[b]It is newer, with more mechanics, more everything. [/b]

It is a build much closer to our full release, so now feedback, thoughts and ideas on new mechanics and elements that you want to see will be more precious than ever.  
Let's create this bakery together! 🍬

[h3]What is different from the demo? [/h3]

[b]In Sweet Start you will be able to:[/b]
[list]
[*] Buy ice cream from factory 🍦
[*] Create cakes, not just cookies and lollipops 🎂
[*] More decorations for your creations 🍰
[*] More furniture 🪑
[*] More products to buy in shops 🛒
[*] Have an employee to take care of your customers 👱
[*] Expand your shop by buying additional land 🏪
[/list]
If you are excited as we are, want to join the hype, have  plenty of things you want to see in the game, come join us on our discord!  💬
[url=https://discord.gg/3MhHsgxXfd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!
Candy Shop Simulator Team
